description: Verifies observer tetrads and their transport: orthonormality of stationary and ZAMO tetrads, the Thomas precession of a circularly moving gyroscope, the Gravity Probe B geodetic precession, the Lense-Thirring precession of a static observer in the Kerr field, and the reduction of Fermi-Walker to parallel transport for geodesic observers.

checks.label: the stationary Schwarzschild tetrad is orthonormal within 1e-12
the ZAMO Schwarzschild tetrad is orthonormal within 1e-12
the ZAMO Kerr tetrad is orthonormal within 1e-10
the gyroscope rotation after one orbit equals -2 pi (gamma - 1) within a relative 1e-4
the transported tetrad stays orthonormal within 1e-10
the theoretical geodetic rate lies between 6.55 and 6.65 arcsec per year
the transported gyroscope reproduces the geodetic rate within 1e-4 arcsec per year
the transported tetrad residual stays below 1e-10
the gyroscope rate of a static observer matches the frame-dragging prediction within a relative 1e-4
the transported tetrad residual stays below 1e-9
a vanishing acceleration reduces Fermi-Walker transport to parallel transport
